matrix_cosec.label: Matrix COSEC (SQL Server)
matrix_cosec.hint: The COSEC database (often named COSEC). Punches are in Mx_ATDEventTrn; MID is the door controller. Very old COSEC servers (SQL Server 2000) need tds_version=7.0 in the extra options.

config.query:
SELECT et.UserID, et.Edatetime AS PunchTime, et.EntryExitType, et.MID AS MasterControllerID
FROM Mx_ATDEventTrn et
WHERE et.Edatetime >= :since
ORDER BY et.Edatetime

essl_etimetracklite.hint: eTimeTrackLite keeps one table per month (DeviceLogs_11_2026). We read each month's table from the last punch onwards.

zk_access.hint: The Access file of ZKTime 5 / ZKAccess (att2000.mdb or access.mdb). Read on the office PC by the connector. Badgenumber is the user id shown on the device.

config.query:
SELECT u.Badgenumber, c.CHECKTIME, c.CHECKTYPE, c.SENSORID
FROM CHECKINOUT c INNER JOIN USERINFO u ON c.USERID = u.USERID
WHERE c.CHECKTIME >= :since
ORDER BY c.CHECKTIME

items.title: How do I download my payslip?
items.body: Open the app, go to Payroll → My payslips and pick the month. Payslips for the last 24 months are available. Former employees can download theirs for 3 years after leaving.

items.title: How do I get a salary certificate or address proof?
items.body: Go to My documents → Request a letter and pick Salary certificate or Address proof. HR approves the request and the signed letter appears in My documents, usually within a day.

items.title: How do I submit tax-saving investment proofs?
items.body: Declare your investments at the start of the financial year under Payroll → Income tax. Upload proofs between January and February so that TDS can be adjusted before March payroll.

items.title: How many leave days do I get?
items.body: Your leave balance is shown under Time → Leave. Earned leave is credited monthly; casual and sick leave are credited at the start of the year as per the leave policy.

items.title: I forgot my laptop password
items.body: Raise a case under IT → Accounts and access. Keep your employee ID ready; IT will verify your identity and reset it within 4 working hours.

items.title: When is salary credited?
items.body: Salary is credited on the last working day of each month. If that day is a bank holiday, it is paid on the previous working day.

items.title: Whom do I contact for a new ID card?
items.body: Raise a case under Admin and facilities → ID and access cards. A lost card is replaced within 2 working days; the first replacement is free.

notices.title: The four labour codes are in force
notices.body: The Code on Wages, the Industrial Relations Code, the Social Security Code and the OSH Code replace 29 older labour laws. Wages must be at least 50% of pay for PF, gratuity and bonus, wages are due by the 7th, and final settlements within 2 working days.

notices.title: Gratuity for fixed-term employees after 1 year
notices.body: Under the Social Security Code, fixed-term employees are entitled to gratuity after one year of continuous service instead of five.

notices.title: New tax regime is the default
notices.body: Employees are taxed under the new regime unless they choose the old one. The rebate makes income up to ₹12 lakh tax-free (₹12.75 lakh for salaried people with the standard deduction).

notices.title: ESI covers gross wages up to ₹21,000
notices.body: Employees earning up to ₹21,000 a month (₹25,000 for people with disabilities) are covered by ESI. Contributions are 0.75% by the employee and 3.25% by the employer.

Face attendance: your consent

We would like to use your face to mark your attendance. If you agree:
- This device takes 3 to 5 pictures of your face and turns them into face templates (a set of numbers). The pictures themselves are not kept.
- The templates are stored encrypted and are used only to recognise you when you clock in at our attendance kiosks, or when you clock in on the web or your phone if the company asks for a selfie check.
- When you punch, a small photo may be kept for a limited number of days so HR can check a doubtful punch. It is then deleted.
- Your face data is not shared with anyone outside the company and is not used for anything else.
- Saying no is fine: you can keep using your employee ID and PIN, and it will not affect your job.
- You can withdraw your consent at any time in My attendance. Your face templates are then deleted at once.
- Your templates are also deleted when you leave the company.

This notice is given under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. For questions or complaints, contact HR or the company's grievance officer.
